correctness.rationale: The unique global complex optimum reduces via reversal to one real t; exact Haar H4 fourth moment is the displayed quartic. Independent finite autocorrelation/quadrature checks support, but do not substitute for, proof.

originality.rationale: Full text of arXiv:2305.16068v1, arXiv:2310.16010v1, and arXiv:2511.08000v1 was inspected in relevant sections; none asserts or implies the exact all-m H4 quartic and sharp cubic boundary layer. Six targeted published mathematical-results searches and external literature searches found no stronger covering theorem. Closest one-generator results concern Hilbert Dirichlet bidisk, and the one-variable geometric three-term example is a norm comparison, not an optimal inverse. Best-knowledge originality, with residual search incompleteness acknowledged.

value.rationale: The canonical finite moving-average/Dirichlet-kernel generators have unit-circle zeros and make degree-one nonlinear inverse approximants a natural filter invariant. Reversal reduces full complex nearest-point geometry for all p>1, and the first nonlinear even Hardy norm has a sharp, non-Hilbert root and error 1/m boundary layer with exact all-length solution. This is motivated structural and asymptotic information, not an arbitrary parameter table.
